title: Bamboo SUP canonical design
description: The physical object only. Rider, ballast and water belong in a conditions file. Frame: x longitudinal, 0 at tail, positive toward bow; y transverse, 0 at centreline, positive to port; z vertical, 0 at the lowest point of the unloaded assembly, positive up.

design_id.description: Permanent identifier, e.g. SUP-001. Suffix letter for minor revisions.

derived_from.description: design_id this was branched from, for traceability.

units.description: Declared explicitly so no consumer has to assume. Keys elsewhere carry unit suffixes to match.

culms.description: Main load-bearing culms. Array order is not significant; placement is absolute.

cross_members.description: Transverse bamboo holding bundle geometry. V0 uses them for mass and trim only.

side.description: Which face of the bundle it lashes to.

lashings.description: Vine/rattan bindings. Mass and location only until a slip/creep model exists.

additional_masses.description: Anything else permanently part of the built object: deck mat, fittings, test hardware.

buoyant.description: True only if this item displaces water when submerged and that volume is modelled.

layout_intent.description: Non-authoritative record of the rule that generated culm placements. Placements remain the source of truth; actual gaps are derived from real diameters.

convergence_ratio.description: Bow lateral offsets as a fraction of tail offsets. 1.0 is parallel.

bow_curve.description: Recurve applied to a culm centreline. Given at design level as the bundle default; a culm may override it.

curve_start_from_bow_mm.description: Distance back from the bow end at which the centreline leaves the straight run.

tip_rise_mm.description: Vertical rise of the culm tip above the straight run.

shape.description: power: z = tip_rise * (s / curve_start_from_bow_mm)^exponent. circular_arc: constant-radius transition, tangent to the straight run.

exponent.description: Only meaningful for shape=power. 2 is a smooth quadratic sweep; higher values concentrate curvature near the tip.

id.description: Position identifier within this design, e.g. M1.

source.description: parametric: idealised culm defined inline (V0). inventory: resolved against data/culms/inventory.csv (V1).

culm_id.description: Required when source=inventory. Must match a culm_id in the inventory CSV.

diameter_tip_mm.description: Equal to diameter_base_mm for a cylindrical V0 culm; smaller for linear taper.

orientation.description: Which end of the culm points at the bow. A design variable to be tested, not a fixed convention.

placement.description: Culms are never exactly parallel: separate tail and bow lateral offsets express splay or convergence. Gaps between neighbours are derived from these plus real diameters, never stated directly.

x_tail_mm.description: Longitudinal position of the culm's aft end. Non-zero values stagger culms of differing length.

z_mm.description: Height of the culm axis above the frame origin.

roll_deg.description: Rotation about the culm's own axis. Governs which way natural curvature and damage face once V1 profiles arrive.

chambers.description: Buoyancy state. A sealed culm displaces its full outside volume; a flooded one displaces only its wall.

flooded_fraction.description: Fraction of internal volume occupied by water. Baseline 0; raised for damaged-culm scenarios.

wall_thickness_mm.description: Required once flooded_fraction is above 0, since displaced volume then depends on wall volume.
